response.justification: Bogdan is a versatile, experienced full-stack engineer with strong TDD/craftsmanship practices, but his career has been overwhelmingly focused on JavaScript/TypeScript, Node.js, and DLang ecosystems rather than Java/Kotlin/JVM. Java appears only briefly (robotic arms, IDE C/C++ work at NI) with no evidence of Spring, Kotlin, or modern JVM tooling, and there is no mention of IDE internals or language-tooling experience relevant to this role.
strengths: 15+ years of diverse, high-quality software engineering experience across many domains
Strong testing/craftsmanship background (TDD, CI/CD, wrote test frameworks like Trial and Fluent-Asserts)
Experience building developer tooling and CLI/IDE-adjacent products (NI LabWindows/CVI C IDE, MCP code generators)
concerns: No demonstrated Kotlin experience and only minimal, dated Java exposure
No evidence of Spring, Quarkus, Hibernate, or enterprise JVM framework experience
Core recent career trajectory (5+ years) is in TypeScript/Node.js/DLang, not JVM ecosystem

key_factors.factor: Strong general software craftsmanship and tooling background
